data.holdout: 2025-07-01 onward — not loaded or inspected until the verdict is written
data.source: binance public klines via data.binance.vision, see data/manifest/

decision_rule.note: Fixed before any result was computed. Not adjustable. Run diagnose.py --null afterwards for the cross-sectional picture; that is exploratory and must be labelled as such.

derived.note: Detection limit: the smallest TRUE annualised Sharpe this design could find with 80% power at alpha=0.05. A null result from this sweep says nothing about edges smaller than this.

hypothesis: Range contraction is claimed to precede expansion in a predictable direction. Stated mechanically: One or more consecutive bars contained within the prior bar's range, followed by a close beyond that range by entry_threshold ATR(14). lookback//10 sets how many consecutive inside bars are required. This sweep tests whether that produces a risk-adjusted edge after realistic costs, once selection across the full parameter space is accounted for. The definition is fixed and hashed before the test runs, so an objection that it was implemented wrong must be raised against this text in advance.

protocol.definition_note: These concepts are usually traded discretionarily. Only the mechanical core is tested here. A null result therefore falsifies the mechanical rule, not every possible discretionary application of the idea — and that limit is stated up front rather than conceded afterwards.
protocol.execution_model: signal from bar t close, held over bar t+1, no partial fills, position capped at 1x notional per side
protocol.method: Fixed rules, no in-sample parameter fitting. Every variant evaluated over the full period; in-sample/out-of-sample splitting is done by CSCV at scoring time.
protocol.survivorship_note: symbols fixed at the start of the period, no delisting selection

search_space.enumeration_note: 6 lookback x 5 entry_threshold x 3 exit_rule x 3 holding_cap_bars x 2 symbols = 540 fully enumerated variants. No variant is excluded after the fact.

family_descriptions.inside_bar_breakout: One or more consecutive bars contained within the prior bar's range, followed by a close beyond that range by entry_threshold ATR(14). lookback//10 sets how many consecutive inside bars are required.

title: Inside bar breakout on BTC and ETH spot, hourly
